experience.title: Senior Software Development Engineer – Founding Team
achievements: Own the backend and applied-AI platform end-to-end — advertiser and competitor ingestion through multimodal analysis, creative strategy, asset generation, and client reporting — for 10+ enterprise pilots.

Built asynchronous onboarding and continuous synchronization across the Meta Marketing API, Meta Ad Library, and AppMagic using BullMQ and Redis leader election — supporting 10+ advertisers and 100+ competitor brands with no client-specific pipelines.

Developed a multimodal analysis system that extracts scene-level video structure and scores creatives across 5 strategic dimensions and 100+ configurable signals via structured Gemini, Claude, and OpenAI workflows.

Designed a versioned knowledge platform combining deterministic SQL metrics with cached LLM-generated strategy — powering 5+ LangGraph workflows, an OAuth-enabled MCP server, and 13+ client-facing report types.

Shipped insight-to-production workflows for storyboards, images, and video using OpenAI, Imagen, Veo, and Bria; implemented tenant- and feature-level LLM cost attribution across 60+ production call sites.
Expanded the Terraform-managed AWS platform to 7 ECS Fargate services across isolated environments — RDS, ElastiCache, ALB, ECR, centralized logging, and OIDC-based CI/CD.
